node.title: Re^3: Printing POD info to terminal window without exiting
node.author: perlfan
node.doctext: Explain to me your objection. [mod://Pod::Usage] seems to rely on underlying "formatters", including perldoc. Does your object rely simply on the hypothetical that $0 can be reassigned or that there exist linux distros that include perl but not perldoc by default, like Debian?
